faq.question: Does Luna work with existing projects?
faq.answer: Yes! Luna can analyze any existing codebase and help improve it with requirements analysis, code review, testing, and documentation generation.

faq.question: Can I use Luna for specific features only?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Luna supports both project-level and feature-level work. Just specify the feature name when prompted.

faq.question: How does Luna track progress?
faq.answer: Luna uses a checkbox-based system in implementation-plan.md files, marking tasks as complete [x] as they're finished.

faq.question: What programming languages are supported?
faq.answer: Luna works with virtually all programming languages and frameworks, analyzing code structure and generating appropriate solutions.
